verdict.rationale: Floot documents a managed Postgres database that the app's endpoints query directly. The assistant builds the database tables for you, and you can browse the tables in-product. Through MCP the AI can run reads, writes and migrations and regenerate typed helpers, so you never leave the builder or AI chat. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the automatic provisioning step and connection wiring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a database provisioned and wired into my app without leaving the builder

citations.quote: A managed Postgres database. Your app's endpoints query it directly, and you can browse the tables and download a backup yourself.
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat
